sources.notes: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 (both this URL and the older /_resources/pdf/guidelines/ URL). Snippet text: 'Why did you choose to study at London South Bank University?' with guidance to 'think about why you chose to study in the UK rather than in your home country, another English-speaking country or country which other students of your nationality chose to study in.' Snippet also: 'The Home Office intends to interview most students who make a Student visa application to assess whether your English language ability meets the required level and whether you are a "genuine student"'; 'You will be interviewed when you attend the visa application centre to submit your application and biometric information.'
